cover:
the 10 minute desk reset
I do every friday

slides.head: 1. clear everything off
slides.body: all of it, onto the floor. you only put back what earns a spot

slides.head: 2. wipe it down
slides.body: a damp cloth and two minutes. the surface looks new again

slides.head: 3. one notebook, one pen
slides.body: everything else lives in a drawer until you need it

slides.head: 4. cables out of sight
slides.body: a single clip under the edge does most of the work

slides.head: 5. set up monday
slides.body: leave the first task open and the chair pushed in

caption: what is on your desk right now?
